summary: Transform groups and flatten one level.
documentation: flatMap applies a callback and flattens array results by exactly one level, combining transformation and one-level flattening.
inputs: An array and a callback returning values or arrays.
returns: A new array with callback arrays flattened once.
caution: It does not recursively flatten deeply nested arrays.
scenarios: Combine line items from several customer orders.
Build one contact list from several departments.
Expand event records into individual time slots.
title: Collect all order items
problem: Given orders with an items array of strings, return a single array of items in order. Keep duplicates; empty orders contribute no items.
goal: Use Array.flatMap() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
